title: Hike in Childcare Fees Following Increase in Government’s Childcare Subsidy
what_it_is: Hike in Childcare Fees Following Increase in Government’s Childcare Subsidy

sections.label: Childcare centres not raising fees
sections.summary: The other 1,200 childcare centres will not adjust their fees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The other 1,200 childcare centres will not be making any adjustments to their fees.

sections.label: Median childcare fee increase
sections.summary: Among centres raising fees in 2020, the median increase is within 5% of fees, around $35.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Of the centres raising fees in 2020, the median increase is within 5% of fees, comparable to previous years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In absolute terms, the median increase is around $35.

sections.label: Additional Subsidy versus fee increase
sections.summary: Families will see the Additional Subsidy for full-day childcare rise by up to $240 per month from January 2020, depending on income.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Compared to the median fee increase of about $35, families will see the Additional Subsidy for full-day childcare increase by up to $240 per month from January 2020, depending on their income levels.

sections.label: Fee reductions and fee caps
sections.summary: Most households earning $12,000 and below should see lower childcare fees, with fee caps falling further from January 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In fact, the vast majority of households earning $12,000 and below ought to see a reduction in childcare fees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But for the vast majority, they should see a fall in childcare fees from January next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And as I said, from January 2021, for Partner Operators, we will bring down the fee caps even further, and thereafter, the Anchor Operators will see a fall as well.

sections.label: Per capita support for families
sections.summary: Families with many dependants and more children in preschool will be looked at on a per capita basis for more support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Apart from looking at total household income, for families with many dependants and more children in preschool, we will look at it from a per capita basis, so that they can get even more support.

sections.label: Working mother status criteria
sections.summary: Working mother status is conferred if a mother works two days a week, or roughly 56 hours a month.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In fact, working mother status is conferred if a mother works for two days a week, or roughly 56 hours a month.
